gizmo.definition: A portable deterministic intelligence engine centered on a Tau Clock for precise, auditable computation.

tau.definition: The circle constant τ = 2π, representing one full turn; symbol of cyclical precision and time in this engine.

deterministic.definition: Predictable outcome given the same initial state and inputs; core property of the Tau Clock.

proof.definition: A finite sequence of well-formed formulas establishing a conclusion via rules of inference.

precision.definition: The quality, condition, or fact of being exact and accurate.
